description_en: Queries the back-to-origin keep-alive connection settings for a domain name
description_zh: 查询域名回源长连接设置
name: DescribeL7UsKeepalive

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a traffic forwarding rule configured for the website service. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

RsKeepalive.description_en: The configured back-to-origin keep-alive connection parameters
RsKeepalive.description_zh: 配置的回源长连接参数

DsKeepaliveTimeout.description_en: The keepalive timeout period of the connection on the DS side
DsKeepaliveTimeout.description_zh: DS 侧长连接的保活超时时间

Enabled.description_en:
Specifies whether the back-to-origin keep-alive connection is enabled. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
是否开启回源长连接。取值：

true：表示开启。
false：表示不开启

KeepaliveRequests.description_en: The number of requests that can be reused over a keep-alive connection
KeepaliveRequests.description_zh: 长连接复用的请求数量

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en: The idle timeout period of the keep-alive connection
KeepaliveTimeout.description_zh: 长连接的空闲超时时间
